mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_template t WHERE
mapper.sql: t.template_code,t.template_name,t.coupon_type,t.face_amount_fen,t.discount_rate_bps,t.threshold_rent_amount_fen,t.applicable_scope_type,t.validity_type,t.valid_days,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(t.valid_start_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS valid_start_at,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(t.valid_end_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS valid_end_at,t.id,t.template_version,t.template_status AS status,CAST(t.issued_count AS CHAR) AS issued_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coupon_template t WHERE ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT FROM coupon_template t WHERE 1=1 AND t.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

mapper.sql: t.id,t.template_id,t.config_json->>'$.condition' AS `condition`,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(t.starts_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS starts_at,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(t.ends_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') AS ends_at,t.config_json->>'$.reason' AS reason,t.status,t.version,CAST(t.issued_quantity AS CHAR) AS issued_quantity
